Merged main again after #2619 and #2622 landed. The conflict at the end of `test_openai.py` kept both tests. One snapshot from main, `test_convert_responses_outputs_non_text_content`, still expected the refusal as a generic `{'type': 'refusal', ...}` part; with this change it is recorded as a text part, so that expectation is updated in the merge commit. The earlier red job on the 3.13 / otel 1 matrix was `test_global_starlette_websocket`, unrelated to this PR.
